product.olivetti-m380-40.summary: The high-end workstation Olivetti offered in September 1991 with an AT bus and a 33 MHz 386.
product.olivetti-m380-40.history: The documentation places M380-40 as the high-end workstation Olivetti offered in September 1991 with an AT bus and a 33 MHz 386.
product.olivetti-m380-40.architecture: Memory organisation determines expansion options. The guide identifies BA262 / BA281. It integrates 82C452 video, 82077 floppy control and 64 KB of cache with an 82385.
product.olivetti-m380-40.firmware: The BIOS revision helps identify the service configuration. The guide records Flash EPROM · 1.09.
product.olivetti-m380-40.verified: The identity was checked in Olivetti documentation. The sheet remains under research.
product.olivetti-m380-40.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
